authorisation: User: yes, proceed to the next useful advance
prior: uniform over the 60 joint labels, NOT over deduplicated responses
horizon_interpretation: two synthetic conditional future responses, NOT an autonomous rollout
observation_contract: six raw log-mass increments on fixed scale-factor grid; no rate renormalisation; latent missing increments integrated under explicit finite law
training_inference: uses continuous horizon-1 labels in independent training worlds only
state_fitting: Brier ERM on training worlds, separately per horizon; exact posterior from same training data may enter frozen library
target: indicator of positive synthetic future structural response
primary_adequacy_method: unchanged group scalar-max empirical Bernstein from DEP-001
certificate_level: local development; class-relative to frozen 131-entry finite library; no human specialist qualification implied

nested_levels.1: 9 affine-current probit-mixture predictors (a function-class underfit control)
nested_levels.2: level 1 plus 60 exact summary-marginal grid predictors and 1 summary posterior predictor
nested_levels.3: level 2 plus 60 observed-history grid predictors and 1 observed-history posterior predictor

sbc_tie_rule: analytic randomized posterior PIT with independent Uniform(0,1) tie fraction
sbc_alarm: DKW with Bonferroni over 24 correct-method case/quantity checks, total alarm probability .01; sensitivity of invalid controls reported separately
posterior_credible_set: joint discrete HPD set with mass at least .9; compare coverage with ACTUAL included posterior mass, not exactly .9
fitted_library_policy: one training-only library per predictive case, fixed across independent test replicates and group-count panels; all exact risks conditional on that library
predictive_truth_checks: finite observation-space enumeration and analytic Gaussian CDF; float64 with mpmath fixture checks, not formal interval arithmetic
false_adequacy_alarm: for each of 15 cells, binomial upper-tail test against p=.05 at .01/15; detects gross excess only; NO minimum power is required
expected_scientific_outcome: report all posterior/identifiability and predictive decisions even when unresolved or low power
structural_checks: shared nuisance integrated after within-world product
failure_policy: retain diagnostics; no logbook or completion on failure; no git commands
success_logbook: new local module entry only after all mandatory gates pass; not live programme closure
replay: same source/plan/environment; same numerical files must match; no claim of fresh evidence
